historical_candidate_evidence.note: Earlier Batch02 content was re-read against the vNext Learning + Content contracts. Accepted semantic upgrades were reused only after fresh current-generation judgment and final-object readback; the old stacked execution model is not revived.

owners.judgment: The ordinary article alone was insufficient for an advanced learner object: per/each and one-in-quantity uses plus the sound-based a/an boundary are high-value hidden branches. Final object exposes them without turning them into learner review debt.
Final object cleanly separates leaving a person/place from giving up a plan while retaining the high-value fixed phrase with abandon as learner-visible Expansion.
One ordinary anatomical sense with useful representative collocations; no hidden modern branch, construction, contrast, or form boundary justifies default Depth.
Modern use is construction-led: abide by and can't/cannot abide must be primary, while archaic dwell/stay remains reference-only. The final object supports local repair on either frame.
Semantics are simple, but the to-infinitive complement is a reusable productive grammar skeleton worth first-class Expansion rather than an incidental example.
Final object keeps capacity/opportunity and competent-person senses, makes be able to the grammar spine, and records the useful can versus be able to slot boundary.
Ordinary not-normal usage is already foregrounded; the economics above-normal branch is correctly low-priority and dated wording remains reference-only.
Adverb and preposition uses share one transparent vehicle-board meaning and the important go/climb aboard and aboard the ship/plane patterns are already present.
Single stable institutional-ending sense with representative high-value collocations; no material learner branch is missing.
The subject-role distinction between things abound and a container abounds in/with things is a real argument-structure boundary and is now explicit.
A high-frequency function word needs more than topic/approximately/around: be about to, how/what about, be all about, that's about it/all, and just about are first-class learner-worthy Expansion.
Five valid modern senses become coherent under one spatial/scale/text axis, with above all, threshold/comparison, and textual-reference patterns exposed as local learning objects.
